people.name: Achan
people.line: An Israelite who stole devoted things, causing Israel's defeat.

people.name: Carmi
people.line: Father of Achan, who stole devoted things

people.name: Zabdi
people.line: Ancestor of Achan, who sinned against Israel

people.name: Zerah
people.line: Son of Judah, twin of Perez

translations.web: He brought near his household man by man, and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.
translations.bsb: And he had the family of Zabdi come forward man by man, and Achan son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was selected.
translations.kjv: And he brought his household man by man; and Achan, the son of Carmi, the son of Zabdi, the son of Zerah, of the tribe of Judah, was taken.
